Standards findings

[P1, blocking] Isolate the trusted driver from candidate Python imports — src/ergora/reference_executor.py:366. The command launches Python with -m from the candidate checkout; the frozen process_job.py:109 preserves that working directory. A candidate containing a top-level ergora package or an imported module such as json.py can therefore execute code before the restricted backend starts. It can leave the checkout unchanged while writing outside it, accessing inherited inference credentials, or fabricating the invocation/result files the parent subsequently trusts. The checkout snapshot does not prevent this. Smallest correction: launch the installed driver with Python isolated mode (-I -m ergora.stage_driver), retaining the original monitor. Add an installed-package regression with candidate import-shadowing files.

Spec findings

[P2, blocking] Disable Git replacement objects when freezing review material — src/ergora/reference_executor.py:169, consumed at :209, :226, :235 and :249. On a resumed workspace whose shared mirror contains a replacement ref—for example, a replacement for a base-only blob deleted by the candidate—the review helper can supply substituted source under the original Git object ID. The frozen verifier explicitly uses --no-replace-objects (harness/git_scope.py:72), so successful verification does not establish that these replacement-aware review reads describe the same objects. Computing SHA-256 over substituted bytes merely records the substitution. Smallest correction: add --no-replace-objects to every command through _git_bytes and cover a replaced base-only blob in a regression.

Prior findings and ownership

The supplied source addresses the reported native dependency mismatch: reference_executor.py:263 requires the original {verification, plan} keys, binds plan to its approved receipt/digest, and reads both artifact sets. Selected backend/mode/policy and MCP package presence checks precede super().__init__; dependency reads consume the remaining aggregate budget, with a final complete-prompt limit retained. Successful monitor recovery now requires invocation evidence and matching result digest. Manifest restoration stages and inspects the complete tree before no-replace publication. The common creation subprocess keeps _Creation's global reader patch outside executor threads. These are source observations, not claims that final regressions passed.

Evidence limits

No tests or model calls were executed by this review. Earlier package results and in-progress R3 checks do not establish final-source success. Two legacy test files are supplied only as baseline-relative hunks. The attachment omits implementations including task_envelopes, reference_inputs/reference_workflows, Sandbox, FileAdapter and processes, and does not contain all 283 frozen files; their complete admission, public guards, lifecycle contracts and byte preservation cannot be independently certified here. Production baseline diffs are also absent, so findings describe current reachable behavior without asserting when it was introduced.
